subject: Business
instructions:
Case report: Supply chain disruption at a bicycle maker.
Your report must:
- Describe the disruption
- Quantify its financial impact
- Identify the root cause
- Compare two alternative suppliers
- Propose a contingency plan
Reports must be 4 to 6 pages. Email your instructor if you need an extension.
draft:
In March a fire closed the only factory that supplied the company's gear shifters, and production stopped for six weeks.
The shutdown cost about $2.1 million in lost sales and $300,000 in overtime to catch up.
The real problem was buying a critical part from a single source, with no backup and only two weeks of stock on hand.
To avoid this happening again, the company should keep eight weeks of safety stock and qualify a second supplier by next year.
